messages:
Maya: Heads-up — saw the gatekeeper approval queue spike during the 03:00 UTC change window. deploy-bot was stuck trying to request canary split approvals for ~6m :exclamation:
Jonah: Saw the same. Lots of approvals pending from the automated queue, UI showed 200+ in-flight. :eyes:
deploy-bot: automated approval request submitted to /rollouts/approve (id=R-2026-38). Response: 429 rate_limited. Retrying in 30s.
SRE-Oncall: Pasted the brief logs from the gate service:
```
2026-03-12T03:02:14Z gatekeeper: enqueue approval R-2026-38 queue_size=213
2026-03-12T03:03:20Z http 429 /api/approvals bulk=50 limit=20
2026-03-12T03:08:20Z gatekeeper: approval worker restart (oom) pid=1234
```
Elaine: OOM restart? That would explain the backlog. Is this the worker that processes manual approval webhooks or the deploy-bot callbacks?
Ryan: It's the approvals worker pool. We rolled a memory-reducing config last week that shrank replica mem to 512MB. Looks like under high bursts it's starving and restarting.
Liz: This impacted a canary for a customer-facing routing change — they hit increased 5xxs during delayed fallback. Need a postmortem summary for the incident report.
Maya: Short term: can we increase worker mem to 1GB and bump concurrency? Also, add a graceful backoff in deploy-bot so it doesn't flood the approval endpoint during a queue recovery.
Jonah: Will open a PR to revert mem change and add config knobs. Also propose changing deploy-bot to use exponential backoff with jitter and respect X-Rate-Limit headers.
SRE-Oncall: I'll scale replicas to 3 in the staging cluster and watch for queue drops. If stable, promote to prod after a 30m observation window.
deploy-bot: Note: added header enforcement patch to avoid parallel retries. Will try to throttle to 5 parallel approval requests.
Elaine: Related UX note — the console approval page should show queue depth and average latency per approve button. PM asked for better visibility so oncall doesn't get pinged blind.
Liz: Agree. Add a telemetry card to the rollouts dashboard: approval-queue-depth, approval-latency p50/p95, and recent worker restarts.
Maya: Action items:
- Jonah: PR to bump mem + backoff change (ETA 2h)
- Ryan/SRE: scale in staging + 30m observe (ETA 15m)
- Devex/Product: add dashboard card (tracking)
- Ops: schedule a one-off change-window extension for the current rollout if we still see >2m stalls after fix (consent from PM)

Maya: Thanks everyone — ping here when staging is green and we'll roll the fix. :thumbsup:
